baseline.meaning: Explode all requested assemblies before subtracting leaf stock; ignores stock of finished and intermediate assemblies.

limitations: Whole-unit, single-period worksheet. Stock is assumed usable and exclusive to this run; assemblies already contain their components. No lead times, scrap, substitution, disassembly, reservations, purchasing or live inventory updates. Held requests are excluded from needs but retained in the audit. Cap checks cover leaf purchases only. Baseline differences are modeled units per item, never measured savings or sums of unlike items.
